metadata.description: Plugins with agents, skills, and commands for Claude Code and six other coding tools. Local plugins are maintained as one Markdown source and adapted to each tool.

plugins.name: accessibility-compliance
plugins.description: WCAG accessibility auditing, compliance validation, UI testing for screen readers, keyboard navigation, and inclusive design

plugins.name: agent-orchestration

plugins.name: agent-teams
plugins.description: Orchestrate multi-agent teams for parallel code review, hypothesis-driven debugging, and coordinated feature development using Claude Code's Agent Teams
